|strategy=By [mailto:joea@decipher.com Joe Alread, Decipher Game Designer]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/small/darthmaulyoungapprentice.html</ref>

The [[Tatooine (Dark){{!}}Tatooine]] version of [[Darth Maul]] was unique in the fact that he didn't really care about characters of lesser ability. Now, when [[Maul]] returns

Not only will he proceed with the beatdown on a pack of small characters, but [[Maul]] is also equipped to deal with the Light Side Jedi that he hates oh so much. From weapon destiny bonuses to lowering a Jedi's power, [[Maul]] can quickly turn a powerful Jedi into a power two or three, forfeit zero card with ability that's going to get hurt badly! And don't forget the [[Clash Of Sabers]] immunity: you no longer have to be afraid of giving [[Maul]] some backup when he desperately needs it.

Combo:

The mysterious Sith Master fuels [[Maul]] with total immunity to attrition and extra defense value, making him extremely difficult to get rid of.
|combos=* [[Darth Maul, Young Apprentice]] + [[Maul Strikes]]<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Darth%20Maul%2C%20Young%20Apprentice</ref>
* [[Darth Maul, Young Apprentice]] + [[The Phantom Menace]] While present with an opponent's Jedi, [[Maul]] is defense value +2 and immune to attrition.
* [[Darth Maul, Young Apprentice]] + [[I Have You Now]] Add one battle destiny (two if Rebel is [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]]) if a Dark Jedi and a Rebel with ability > 2 are involved in the same battle.
* [[Darth Maul, Young Apprentice]] + [[Force Field]] Cancels an attempt to target a Dark Jedi with a character weapon.
